hero.title: Connect the people building the future with the people preparing for it.
hero.description: AI & Cyber Exchange is a community-driven professional forum for AI and cybersecurity — built on education, exposure to technology, professional growth, and meaningful connections.

items.title: Educational first
items.description: Sessions explain problems, technology, and lessons learned. They are not product pitches.

items.title: Community-driven
items.description: AICX is a forum run for its community. It is not a training company, a consultancy, or a vendor.

items.title: Two-way
items.description: Questions and discussion are part of every session, not an afterthought at the end.

items.question: What is a CyberSaturday?
items.answer: A recurring session where one company, startup, or technology team working in AI, cybersecurity, or related emerging technology demonstrates its work and discusses it with the community.

items.question: Who can attend?
items.answer: Anyone with an interest in AI and cybersecurity — from directors and senior practitioners to engineers, students, early-career professionals, and people transitioning into the field.

items.question: Do I need a security background to get value from a session?
items.answer: No. Presenters explain the problem they are solving and why it matters before they demonstrate anything, and attendees are encouraged to ask questions at any level.

items.question: Are sessions sales presentations?
items.answer: No. Sessions focus on practical demonstrations, real-world use cases, emerging challenges, and the ideas behind the technology — not simply product promotion.

items.question: How can my company present?
items.answer: Get in touch through the Present With Us page. Tell us about your team, what you are building, and what you would like to show the community.

aicx.name: AI & Cyber Exchange
aicx.tagline: Where AI, cybersecurity, and real-world innovation meet.
aicx.positioning: AI & Cyber Exchange brings together the people building emerging AI and cybersecurity technologies with the people learning, applying, and shaping them.
aicx.mission: Connect the people building the future with the people preparing for it.
longDescription: AI & Cyber Exchange brings together cybersecurity and AI professionals, technology companies, startups, researchers, practitioners, students, and people transitioning into the field to learn directly from the people building and applying today's emerging technologies.

At each CyberSaturday, we feature a company, startup, or technology team working at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity. Sessions focus on practical demonstrations, real-world use cases, emerging security challenges, and the ideas behind the technologies — not simply product promotion.

The goal is to create a space where experienced professionals can discover emerging technologies, practitioners can expand their knowledge, and people entering the field can learn from the companies and experts actively shaping it.

differentiator.heading: Not another presentation-only meetup.
differentiator.lead: AI & Cyber Exchange is built around direct exposure to the people and technologies shaping the industry. Each session brings a company, startup, or technology team into the community to:
items: Explain the problem they are solving
Share lessons from building or deploying their solutions

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: The company introduces the problem and why it matters.

steps.title: See
steps.description: The team demonstrates its technology, platform, workflow, or solution.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Attendees learn how the technology fits into real-world AI and cybersecurity environments.

steps.title: Discuss
steps.description: The community interacts directly with the presenters.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Attendees and presenters can continue conversations beyond the session.

groups.title: Cybersecurity Leaders
groups.description: Directors, managers, security leaders, and technology executives.

groups.title: Experienced Practitioners
groups.description: Security engineers, architects, SOC professionals, threat intelligence professionals, cybersecurity analysts, and AI/security practitioners.

groups.title: Technology Professionals
groups.description: Software engineers, AI engineers, developers, and cloud and infrastructure professionals.

groups.title: Emerging Professionals
groups.description: Students, aspiring cybersecurity professionals, career transitioners, and early-career practitioners.

topics.note: Each session focuses on its presenter’s work, so no single session covers every area. Over time, these are the areas the community explores.

items.title: Explore emerging technology
items.description: Get early exposure to AI and cybersecurity technologies as they are being built and deployed.

items.title: See real demonstrations
items.description: Watch the technology work, not only the slides that describe it.

items.title: Learn from the builders
items.description: Hear directly from the practitioners and technology teams doing the work.

items.title: Ask your questions
items.description: Put your questions to the presenters and hear what others in the room want to know.

items.title: Discover new approaches
items.description: See different ways teams are approaching security and AI problems.

items.title: Widen your perspective
items.description: Connect with companies and professionals across the industry, at every stage of their careers.

items.title: Reach a diverse technical audience
items.description: Present to security leaders, practitioners, engineers, AI professionals, and people entering the field.

items.title: Demonstrate your technology directly
items.description: Show how it works in a live session rather than describing it from a distance.

items.title: Build technical credibility
items.description: Explain the problem, the approach, and the trade-offs to an audience that asks informed questions.

items.title: Start meaningful conversations
items.description: Open discussions with practitioners and leaders who work on the problems you are solving.

items.title: Introduce emerging technology
items.description: Bring new ideas and approaches to a community that is actively looking for them.

items.title: Give back
items.description: Help educate students, career transitioners, and professionals growing into the field.

items.title: Meet future collaborators
items.description: Create opportunities to connect with potential customers, partners, collaborators, and future talent.

paragraphs: We believe professional growth happens when people have access to ideas, technology, and the people behind them.

That means creating a space where an experienced security architect can discover a new technology, a student can see how an emerging company is solving a real problem, and a career transitioner can learn directly from professionals working in the field.
philosophy.closing: Everyone comes to learn something. Everyone has something to contribute.
